question: Which of the following statements best describes Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw's achievement?

options.text: She is India's first woman to head a top biotech company.
She was honored for developing India's COVID vaccine.
She launched India's first nanotechnology research hub.

solution:
The correct answer is __**She is India's first woman to head a top biotech company.**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 
• **Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw** is a renowned Indian entrepreneur who founded **Biocon Limited**, one of India's leading biotechnology companies, in **1978**. 
• She is recognized as **India's first woman to head a top biotech company**, breaking barriers in a male-dominated industry. 
• Her achievements have made her one of the most influential figures in the global biotech space and earned her numerous awards, including the prestigious **Padma Shri** in **1989** and the **Padma Bhushan** in **2005**. 
• Under her leadership, Biocon pioneered innovations such as affordable insulin and generic biologics, contributing significantly to healthcare accessibility worldwide.
